liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Jack Straw** (2 reviews): Jerry's solos in Jack Straw are a highlight of the first set; Reviewer found the opening Jack Straw underwhelming [22][25]
- **Louie Louie** (2 reviews): Reviewer streamed the show mainly for the Louie Louie; Reviewer thinks Louie Louie is a song the band wasn't suited to play [24][30]
- **Bertha** (2 reviews): The solo in Bertha gets a little sloppy [27][28]
- **Terrapin Station** (2 reviews): Reviewer singles out Terrapin Station, along with Peggy-O and Looks Like Rain, as outstanding; Reviewer rates this the best Terrapin they saw, though perhaps topped by a Furthur Terrapin Suite [20][30]
- **Truckin'** (2 reviews): The whole house sings the 'long, strange trip' line while the band commits fully [27][28]
- **Althea** (1 review): Jerry's vocal pronunciation in Althea is delightful, and his playing is solid too [25]
- **When I Paint My Masterpiece** (1 review): Peggy-O leads into Masterpiece in the first set [23]
- **Looks Like Rain** (1 review): Reviewer, who saw over 100 shows, rates this the best Looks Like Rain they heard [30]

## Setlist highlights

- **Louie Louie**: rare: 9 archived performances [32]

## The recordings

- **gd1988-09-20.sbd.130698.MrBill.flac16** (recommended): soundboard; 19 songs; 129 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Compared with the compressed shnid 2422 soundboard, this upgrade has natural dynamic range, better clarity and stage presence [1]
- **gd1988-09-20.142131.OTS.Schoeps.PCM.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: source not stated; 18 songs; 157 min [2]
- **gd1988-09-20.152581.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: soundboard; 18 songs; 145 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]
- **gd88-09-20.sbd.jeff.2422.sbeok.shnf**: soundboard; 18 songs; 139 min; rated 3.64/5 by 11 [5]. Said about its sound: Phil's bass is clearly audible, and overall recording quality is very good; Sound is very good, with no post-drums problems noticed; Reviewer says the show sounds great, with no complaints [20][24][31]
- **gd1988-09-20.152253.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: soundboard; 18 songs; 145 min [7]
- **gd88-09-20.set1.sbd.gans-samaritano.28450.sbeok.flacf**: soundboard; 8 songs; 54 min; rated 4/5 by 3 [19]

## Around the show

- The Garden run lasted September 12-24, with the 17th and 21st off [23]
- The soundboard captures the crowd screaming loudly, adding to the high energy of the first set [23]
- Opening featured a Star Spangled Banner tease and about five minutes of tuning before Jack Straw [25]
- A long Garden series suggests the band loved playing there [27]
- A long Garden series suggests the band loved playing there [28]
- This was night six of a nine-night run at Madison Square Garden [2]
- Reviewer judges it the best show of this Madison Square Garden run, though not an all-time great [22]
- Bertha going into Cumberland Blues was an unusual placement for the period [24]
- Reviewer ranks it among the top five of 1988, alongside Hampton in March and Rochester on 6/30 [26]

## Tapers and lineage

- **gd1988-09-20.sbd.130698.MrBill.flac16**: transferred by Bill Guarneri; source: Recording Info: SBD > DAT > C > DAT; Transfer Info:; DAT > Sony D8 > WAV > Sound Forge 10 > TLH > FLAC [1]. Also: A 36-second patch at the start of disc 1 track 6 comes from audience source shnid 31991; A tiny digital blip on disc 1 track 4 near 1:45 is on the uploader's DAT [1]
- **gd1988-09-20.142131.OTS.Schoeps.PCM.Mattes.Miller.Noel.t-flac1644**: taped by Ted Mattes and Don Crandall & Chris Huron; transferred by Charlie Miller and Joe Noel; source: Don Crandall & Chris Huron Recording (OTS): Schoeps CMC3/MK4 > PCM (Nakamichi DMP-100) (Sony ESX-HiFi/L-750 Beta tape); Charlie Miller [2]
- **gd1988-09-20.152581.UltraMatrix.sbd.cm.miller.t.flac16**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 14, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [3]. Also: Patch source came from Rich Gastwirt and Sirmick; This is a 24-bit to 16-bit conversion at 44.1 kHz of the 152253 release [3]
- **gd88-09-20.sbd.jeff.2422.sbeok.shnf**: source: SBD> DAT> Casette Master> DAT> Montego II> CDR> EAC> SHN [5]
- **gd1988-09-20.152253.ultramatrix.miller.flac2496**: taped by Don Pearson and Dan Healy; transferred by All Transfers and Mastering by Charlie Miller  April 14, 2021; source: UltraMatrix SBD > Cassette Master (TDK MA-XG) [7]. Also: Patch source came from Rich Gastwirt and Sirmick [7]
- **gd88-09-20.set1.sbd.gans-samaritano.28450.sbeok.flacf**: transferred by Joe Samaritano; source: Soundboard (Set 1 Only) [19]. Also: This first-set source upgrades an earlier one that had the first 10-15 seconds of Masterpiece cut off [22]
